Enhanced Button: Elevate Your Shadcn Experience

Hello everyone, Welcome To React Awesome channel, On the channel you will find a lot of interesting things. Please Don't Forget Like, Subscribe And Share.

Enhanced Button. An extension of the default shadcn-button component, this innovation is set to redefine the way you approach button styles and features in your projects.

Enhanced Button takes the familiar shadcn-button and introduces a spectrum of new and aesthetically pleasing styles. Elevate your design game with styles that go beyond the ordinary, adding a touch of diversity to the Shadcn design system.

Github: https://github.com/jakobhoeg/enhanced-button
